results.note: rocWMMA headers remain absent from /srv/vm-shared/rocm/rocm-head, but a CMake-built HIP inline-asm primitive now proves the halfword LDS plus raw buffer-store surface is expressible without rocWMMA.

results.decision: This retires the broad missing-primitive hypothesis: HIP inline asm can emit the RADV-like store-side surface on gfx1151 without rocWMMA. It is not a production route because it has no live WMMA fragment integration or llama.cpp tensor ABI. The remaining Q8/Q6 gap is the integration contract: combine this low-barrier halfword LDS plus 192 raw buffer-store topology with the real WMMA fragment lane mapping, RADV-like outstanding LDS-load issue window, and acceptable VGPR pressure.

results.decision: The gfx1151 HIP wave64 WMMA builtin can hold two independent 16x16 output tiles in low/high accumulator halves only when the source issues separate low-OPSEL and high-OPSEL WMMA instructions. That makes row+16 high-half writeback semantically valid for an explicit dual-OPSEL computation, but it does not rescue the rejected Q8_0 fullpair route: reading both halves after a single selected-OPSEL WMMA is not a valid second tile, and using both halves this way would add WMMA work rather than explain RADV large-route parity with the same 32-WMMA schedule. Future Q8 direct-WMMA work should keep selected-half ownership unless a lower-level cooperative-matrix primitive exposes RADV store semantics directly.
